analysis.professional_summary: Sagar Tamang is a Master of Computer Applications student at IIT Patna with a strong academic background, including a Gold Medalist BCA from Assam Kaziranga University. He has experience as an AI Engineer at TwoSpoon AI and prior internships in AI/software engineering at LeapX AI, NITS Silchar, Composio, and Success Scholar. He has authored multiple research papers on NLP, cybercrime, and AI forecasting, with several best paper awards.
